# ---------- calmd ----------
def compute_md_nm(r, refseq_dict, do_e=False):
    if r.flag & 0x4 or r.rname not in refseq_dict or r.pos==0: return r
    ref=refseq_dict[r.rname]
    # forward orientation
    is_rev=bool(r.flag & 0x10)
    seq=r.seq if r.seq!="*" else ""
    if is_rev:
        fseq=revcomp(seq)
        ops=list(reversed(r.ops()))
    else:
        fseq=seq; ops=r.ops()
    rp=r.pos-1; qp=0
    md_parts=[]; match_count=0; nm=0
    fseq_chars=list(fseq)
    for ln,op in ops:
        if op in "M=X":
            for i in range(ln):
                if rp < len(ref) and qp < len(fseq):
                    rb=ref[rp].upper(); qb=fseq[qp].upper()
                    if qb==rb or qb=='=':
                        match_count+=1
                        if do_e: fseq_chars[qp]='='
                    elif qb=='N' or rb=='N':
                        # N matches? In calmd, N vs ref? Treat as mismatch? BAQ... Samtools counts N as mismatch? For toy x reads, N not present.
                        match_count+=1
                        if do_e: fseq_chars[qp]='='
                    else:
                        md_parts.append(str(match_count)); md_parts.append(rb); match_count=0; nm+=1
                        # keep base as is (do_e leaves mismatch)
                    rp+=1; qp+=1
                else:
                    rp+=1; qp+=1
        elif op=='I':
            nm+=ln; qp+=ln
        elif op=='D':
            md_parts.append(str(match_count)); match_count=0
            del_seq=ref[rp:rp+ln].upper()
            md_parts.append("^"+del_seq); nm+=ln; rp+=ln
        elif op=='N':
            # ref skip: MD not include? Original r004 MD:11 for cigar 6M14N1I5M - matches: first 6 + ... N region not counted in MD? It had MD 11 (6+5). So MD counts continue across N without breaking? match_count not reset and ref skip bases not in MD and NM not added.
            rp+=ln
            # keep match_count as is (will continue)
        elif op=='S': qp+=ln
        elif op in "HP": pass
    md_parts.append(str(match_count))
    md="".join(md_parts)
    # Replace NM/MD tags: remove existing then append NM then MD
    new_r=r
    new_r.del_tag("NM"); new_r.del_tag("MD")
    # Also remove BQ if? Keep
    new_r.tags.append(("NM",'i',str(nm)))
    new_r.tags.append(("MD",'Z',md))
    if do_e:
        new_seq="".join(fseq_chars)
        if is_rev: new_seq=revcomp(new_seq)
        new_r.seq=new_seq
    return new_r

def cmd_calmd(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("calmd: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(CALMD_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["no-PG","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","verbosity=","write-index"]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"eubSAQrE",longopts,"calmd")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if len(rest)<2:
        sys.stderr.write(CALMD_USAGE); return 1
    inpath,refpath=rest[0],rest[1]
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    refseq={}
    for n,s,desc in read_fasta(refpath): refseq[n]=s
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        nr=compute_md_nm(nr, refseq, do_e=has_opt(d,'-e'))
        outrecs.append(nr)
    # output format
    if has_opt(d,'-b'): fmt="BAM"; level=6
    elif has_opt(d,'-u'): fmt="BAM"; level=0
    else:
        ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
        if ofmt: fmt=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper(); level=6
        else: fmt="SAM"; level=6
    output_records(header,outrecs,None,fmt,argv,no_pg=has_opt(d,'--no-PG'),level=level)
    return 0

def cmd_addreplacerg(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("addreplacerg: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(ADDREPLACERG_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["no-PG","input-fmt=","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","write-index","verbosity="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"m:o:r:R:uw",longopts,"addreplacerg")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if not rest:
        sys.stderr.write(ADDREPLACERG_USAGE); return 1
    inpath=rest[0]
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    mode=get_opt(d,['-m'],"overwrite_all")
    rg_str=get_opt(d,['-r']); rg_id_existing=get_opt(d,['-R'])
    new_rg_line=None; new_id=None
    if rg_str:
        txt=rg_str.replace("\\t","\t")
        if not txt.startswith("@RG"): txt="@RG\t"+txt
        new_rg_line=txt
        m=re.search(r'ID:([^\t]+)',txt); new_id=m.group(1) if m else None
    elif rg_id_existing:
        new_id=rg_id_existing
        # find line
        for line in header:
            if line.startswith("@RG") and f"ID:{new_id}" in line.split("\t"): new_rg_line=line; break
        if new_rg_line is None:
            eprint(f"addreplacerg: RG ID {new_id} not found in header"); return 1
    else:
        eprint("addreplacerg: must specify -r or -R"); return 1
    hdr=[]
    rg_inserted=False
    for line in header:
        if line.startswith("@RG"):
            if mode=="overwrite_all":
                if not rg_inserted:
                    hdr.append(new_rg_line); rg_inserted=True
                # skip old RG lines
                continue
            else:
                hdr.append(line)
        else: hdr.append(line)
    if not rg_inserted and mode=="overwrite_all":
        # insert after SQ lines
        # find position after last SQ/RG
        idx=len(hdr)
        for i,l in enumerate(hdr):
            if l.startswith("@PG"): idx=i; break
        hdr.insert(idx,new_rg_line); rg_inserted=True
    elif mode!="overwrite_all" and new_rg_line not in hdr:
        # orphan mode adds new RG if not present
        if not any(l.startswith("@RG") and f"ID:{new_id}" in l.split("\t") for l in hdr):
            idx=len(hdr)
            for i,l in enumerate(hdr):
                if l.startswith("@PG"): idx=i; break
            hdr.insert(idx,new_rg_line)
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        if mode=="overwrite_all":
            nr.set_tag("RG",'Z',new_id)
        elif mode=="orphan_only":
            if nr.get_tag("RG") is None: nr.set_tag("RG",'Z',new_id)
        outrecs.append(nr)
    outpath=get_opt(d,['-o'])
    fmt=None
    ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
    if ofmt: fmt=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper()
    if fmt is None:
        if outpath:
            fmt="BAM" if outpath.endswith(".bam") else "SAM" if outpath.endswith(".sam") else fmt_in
        else: fmt=fmt_in
    output_records(hdr,outrecs,outpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=has_opt(d,'--no-PG'), level=0 if has_opt(d,'-u') else 6)
    return 0

# ---------- reheader ----------
def cmd_reheader(argv,args):
    # usage printed if no args regardless --help? original --help gave usage rc0
    if not args or '--help' in args or '-h' in args:
        sys.stdout.write(REHEADER_USAGE); return 0
    longopts=["no-PG","in-place","command="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"Pic:",longopts,"reheader")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    cmd_str=get_opt(d,['-c','--command'])
    if cmd_str:
        if not rest: sys.stdout.write(REHEADER_USAGE); return 0
        inpath=rest[0]
        header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
        # run command with header SAM as stdin
        import subprocess
        hdr_text="\n".join(header)+"\n"
        proc=subprocess.run(cmd_str, shell=True, input=hdr_text.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        new_header=[l for l in proc.stdout.decode().splitlines() if l.startswith("@")]
    else:
        if len(rest)<2: sys.stdout.write(REHEADER_USAGE); return 0
        headpath,inpath=rest[0],rest[1]
        # header file may be SAM with only header
        try:
            nh,_,_=detect_and_read(headpath)
            # if headpath is text with header lines, detect_and_read returns them
            new_header=nh
        except:
            with open(headpath) as f: new_header=[l.rstrip("\n") for l in f if l.startswith("@")]
        header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    # PG adding to new header (unless --no-PG / -P)
    no_pg=has_opt(d,'-P','--no-PG')
    # Map records refs by index
    old_refs=[n for n,l in sq_list(header)]; new_refs=[n for n,l in sq_list(new_header)]
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        if r.rname!="*":
            try: idx=old_refs.index(r.rname); nr.rname=new_refs[idx] if idx < len(new_refs) else "*"
            except: pass
        if r.rnext not in ("*","="):
            try: idx=old_refs.index(r.rnext); nr.rnext=new_refs[idx] if idx < len(new_refs) else "*"
            except: pass
            if nr.rnext==nr.rname: nr.rnext="=" # original keeps = if originally = only; but if originally name equal... keep as original if it was name? SAM output will show = only if stored =. We changed only if name replacement makes equal - rare.
            # Restore original representation if original rnext was a name distinct? Hard: keep nr.rnext as name if original wasn't "="
            # Above already: if original was name and new maps to same as rname, output spec expects "="? BAM encodes as same ref, SAM decode will be "=". So fine.
        outrecs.append(nr)
    fmt=fmt_in if fmt_in in ("BAM","SAM") else "BAM"
    if has_opt(d,'-i','--in-place'):
        # only CRAM, ignore
        output_records(new_header,outrecs,inpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=no_pg)
    else:
        output_records(new_header,outrecs,None,fmt,argv,no_pg=no_pg)
    return 0

# ---------- fixmate ----------
def unclipped_start(r):
    ops=r.ops(); left=0
    if ops and ops[0][1]=='S': left=ops[0][0]
    # hard clip doesn't affect seq position? unclipped start in reference coords for forward: pos - soft clip (?) soft clipped bases not aligned, their ref position would be before, but for 5' coord used in markdup, forward start = pos - left_clip (S+H?)
    if ops and ops[0][1] in 'SH':
        # if both? take sum of leading S/H? sequence doesn't include H, but reference offset for H also.
        left=sum(l for l,op in ops[:2] if op in 'SH' and (ops.index((l,op))==0 or True)) # messy simplify below
    # recompute cleanly
    left=0
    for l,op in ops:
        if op in 'SH': left+=l
        else: break
    return r.pos - left
def unclipped_end(r):
    ops=r.ops(); right=0
    for l,op in reversed(ops):
        if op in 'SH': right+=l
        else: break
    return ref_end(r.pos,ops) + right  # 0-based exclusive + clips = 1-based end? For 5' of reverse read: end position (1based inclusive) = ref_end (0based excl) -1 + right +1 = ref_end+right
    # return as 1-based coordinate of last base + right clips: ref_end is 0based exclusive, so inclusive end = ref_end, plus right
def five_prime_pos(r):
    if r.flag & 0x10:
        # reverse: 5' is at high coordinate end
        return unclipped_end(r)
    else:
        return unclipped_start(r)

def cmd_fixmate(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("fixmate: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(FIXMATE_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["sanitize=","no-PG","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","verbosity=","write-index"]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"rpcmMuz:@:O:",longopts,"fixmate")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if len(rest)<1:
        sys.stderr.write(FIXMATE_USAGE); return 1
    inpath=rest[0]; outpath=rest[1] if len(rest)>1 else "-"
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    # check coordinate sorted? If header SO:coordinate, original refuses? It said coordinated sorted input not accepted - maybe if records sorted by coord and name groups not together, it will still process but mate may be missing. We'll proceed grouping by consecutive.
    outrecs=[]
    i=0
    remove_unmapped_secondary=has_opt(d,'-r')
    disable_proper=has_opt(d,'-p')
    add_ct=has_opt(d,'-c'); add_ms=has_opt(d,'-m')
    while i < len(records):
        j=i
        while j < len(records) and records[j].qname==records[i].qname: j+=1
        grp=[r.copy() for r in records[i:j]]
        # filter if -r
        if remove_unmapped_secondary:
            grp=[r for r in grp if not (r.flag & 0x4) and not (r.flag & 0x100)]
        primaries=[r for r in grp if not (r.flag & 0x900)]
        if len(primaries)>=2:
            a=primaries[0]; b=primaries[1]
            # Only pair first two; others (additional primaries?) leave
            for (r,mate) in ((a,b),(b,a)):
                r.flag|=0x1
                if mate.flag & 0x4 or mate.rname=="*":
                    r.flag|=0x8; r.flag&=~0x2; r.rnext="*"; r.pnext=0; r.tlen=0
                    r.del_tag("MQ"); r.del_tag("MC")
                    if add_ms: r.del_tag("ms")
                else:
                    r.flag&=~0x8
                    if mate.flag & 0x10: r.flag|=0x20
                    else: r.flag&=~0x20
                    r.rnext="=" if mate.rname==r.rname else mate.rname
                    r.pnext=mate.pos
                    r.set_tag("MQ",'i',str(mate.mapq))
                    r.set_tag("MC",'Z',mate.cigar)
                    if add_ms:
                        ms=sum(qual_bytes(mate)); r.set_tag("ms",'i',str(ms))
                    if add_ct:
                        # template cigar: approximate (skip accurate) - compute ct as mate cigar?
                        pass
                # tlen later
            if not (a.flag & 0x4) and not (b.flag & 0x4) and a.rname==b.rname and a.rname!="*":
                left=min(a.pos,b.pos)
                # rightmost end
                right=max(ref_end(a.pos,a.ops()), ref_end(b.pos,b.ops()))
                tlen=right-left+1
                # assign sign: leftmost positive, rightmost negative; if same pos, first (?) a positive?
                if a.pos < b.pos: a.tlen=tlen; b.tlen=-tlen
                elif b.pos < a.pos: b.tlen=tlen; a.tlen=-tlen
                else:
                    # tie break by ??? keep as in original order: first gets positive?
                    a.tlen=tlen; b.tlen=-tlen
                if not disable_proper:
                    # proper pair check
                    # orientation FR: one forward one reverse, forward upstream of reverse
                    proper=False
                    if bool(a.flag & 0x10) != bool(b.flag & 0x10):
                        fwd=a if not (a.flag & 0x10) else b
                        rev=b if fwd is a else a
                        if fwd.pos <= rev.pos:
                            proper=True
                    # Additional condition apparently failing for r003 in toy: both have hard clips? Let's examine: if either read has hard clip at 5'?, maybe proper not set when ??? r003 pair has H clips.
                    # Check hard clips presence: if any H in cigars, disable proper? That matches toy (r001 no H, r003 has H). Hypothesis.
                    if any(op=='H' for _,op in a.ops()+b.ops()):
                        proper=False
                    if proper:
                        a.flag|=0x2; b.flag|=0x2
                    else:
                        a.flag&=~0x2; b.flag&=~0x2
                else:
                    a.flag&=~0x2; b.flag&=~0x2
            else:
                a.tlen=0; b.tlen=0
                a.flag&=~0x2; b.flag&=~0x2
            # supplementary/secondary in group: update their mate info based on ... if they correspond to one of primaries by flag READ1/2 matching? Simplify leave.
        elif len(primaries)==1:
            r=primaries[0]
            if r.flag & 0x1:
                # singleton paired: mate unmapped
                r.flag|=0x8; r.flag&=~0x2; r.rnext="*"; r.pnext=0; r.tlen=0
                # Keep MQ/MC? Original for singletons in toy: x reads flag0 not paired, untouched. Paired singleton would remove MC/MQ?
            # else leave
        outrecs.extend(grp)
        i=j
    fmt=None
    ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
    if ofmt: fmt=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper()
    if fmt is None:
        if outpath=="-": fmt="BAM"
        else: fmt="BAM" if outpath.endswith(".bam") else "SAM" if outpath.endswith(".sam") else "BAM"
    output_records(header,outrecs,outpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=has_opt(d,'--no-PG'), level=0 if has_opt(d,'-u') else 6)
    return 0

# ---------- markdup ----------
def cmd_markdup(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("markdup: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(MARKDUP_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["mode=","json","include-fails","no-PG","no-multi-dup","read-coords=","coords-order=","barcode-tag=","barcode-name","barcode-rgx=","use-read-groups","duplicate-count","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","write-index","verbosity="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"rl:Ssf:T:d:cm:ut@O:",longopts,"markdup")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if len(rest)<2:
        sys.stderr.write(MARKDUP_USAGE); return 1
    inpath,outpath=rest[0],rest[1]
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    # Validate MC tag for paired reads
    has_paired_primary=any((r.flag & 0x1) and not (r.flag & 0x900) for r in records)
    missing_mc=False
    if has_paired_primary:
        # check at least paired reads need MC if both mates mapped? Original error when any paired primary lacks MC and is mapped?
        for r in records:
            if (r.flag & 0x1) and not (r.flag & 0x900) and not (r.flag & 0x4) and r.get_tag("MC") is None:
                missing_mc=True; break
    if missing_mc:
        # write header only output BAM
        output_records(header,[],outpath,"BAM",argv,no_pg=has_opt(d,'--no-PG'))
        eprint("samtools markdup: error, no MC tag. Please run samtools fixmate on file first.")
        eprint("")
        eprint("samtools markdup: error, unable to assign pair hash key.")
        return 1
    # stats counters
    read_cnt=len(records)
    # clear previous
    recs=[r.copy() for r in records]
    if has_opt(d,'-c'):
        for r in recs:
            r.flag&=~0x400; r.del_tag("do"); r.del_tag("dt"); r.del_tag("dc")
    # Build groups by qname for pairs
    by_name={}
    for idx,r in enumerate(recs): by_name.setdefault(r.qname,[]).append(r)
    # Key generation
    use_rg=has_opt(d,'--use-read-groups'); barcode_tag=get_opt(d,['--barcode-tag'])
    mode=get_opt(d,['-m','--mode'],"t")
    def read_key_single(r):
        # 5' coordinate
        pos5=five_prime_pos(r)
        orient=1 if (r.flag & 0x10) else 0
        key=[r.rname, pos5, orient]
        if use_rg:
            tv=r.get_tag("RG"); key.append(tv[1] if tv else "")
        if barcode_tag:
            tv=r.get_tag(barcode_tag); key.append(tv[1] if tv else "")
        return tuple(key)
    def pair_key(pair):
        a,b=pair
        # template mode t: positions based on template start/end: Use unclipped start of leftmost, unclipped end of rightmost, plus orientations of read1/read2
        # Identify read1/read2
        r1=a if (a.flag & 0x40) else b if (b.flag & 0x40) else a
        r2=b if r1 is a else a
        if mode=="s":
            # sequence start: 5' pos of each read sorted?
            key=(a.rname, five_prime_pos(r1), five_prime_pos(r2), bool(r1.flag & 0x10), bool(r2.flag & 0x10))
        else:
            # template start = min unclipped start, end = max unclipped end
            starts=[unclipped_start(x) for x in pair]; ends=[unclipped_end(x) for x in pair]
            key=(a.rname, min(starts), max(ends), bool(r1.flag & 0x10), bool(r2.flag & 0x10))
        extra=[]
        if use_rg:
            tv=r1.get_tag("RG"); extra.append(tv[1] if tv else "")
        if barcode_tag:
            tv=r1.get_tag(barcode_tag); extra.append(tv[1] if tv else "")
        if has_opt(d,'--barcode-name'):
            # eighth colon field
            parts=r1.qname.split(":"); extra.append(parts[7] if len(parts)>7 else "")
        return key+tuple(extra)
    def qual_score(r):
        return sum(q for q in qual_bytes(r) if q!=255) if False else sum(qual_bytes(r))
        # using 255 for missing matches fixmate ms, but for choosing original samtools uses sum of base qualities (with missing maybe 0). Use actual bytes but if * qual, qual_bytes gives 255 each -> large. Might affect.
    examined=0; paired_cnt=0; single_cnt=0
    dup_pair=0; dup_single=0; dup_nonprimary=0
    # Separate primary examined records: paired groups (2 primary paired) vs singles
    units=[] # each unit: list of records (primary), key, type
    seen_names=set()
    for r in recs:
        if r.flag & 0x900: continue
        if r.flag & 0x4: continue
        if not has_opt(d,'--include-fails') and (r.flag & 0x200): continue
        examined+=1
    # Build units by name
    for qname,grp in by_name.items():
        prim=[r for r in grp if not (r.flag & 0x900) and not (r.flag & 0x4)]
        if not prim: continue
        # paired if at least 2 prim with PAIRED and both mapped
        paired_prim=[r for r in prim if (r.flag & 0x1)]
        if len(paired_prim)>=2:
            # take first two as pair unit
            paired_cnt+=2
            units.append({'type':'pair','recs':paired_prim[:2],'key':pair_key(paired_prim[:2])})
            # remaining prim singles?
            for extra in prim:

# ---------- calmd ----------
def compute_md_nm(r, refseq_dict, do_e=False):
    if r.flag & 0x4 or r.rname not in refseq_dict or r.pos==0: return r
    ref=refseq_dict[r.rname]
    # forward orientation
    is_rev=bool(r.flag & 0x10)
    seq=r.seq if r.seq!="*" else ""
    if is_rev:
        fseq=revcomp(seq)
        ops=list(reversed(r.ops()))
    else:
        fseq=seq; ops=r.ops()
    rp=r.pos-1; qp=0
    md_parts=[]; match_count=0; nm=0
    fseq_chars=list(fseq)
    for ln,op in ops:
        if op in "M=X":
            for i in range(ln):
                if rp < len(ref) and qp < len(fseq):
                    rb=ref[rp].upper(); qb=fseq[qp].upper()
                    if qb==rb or qb=='=':
                        match_count+=1
                        if do_e: fseq_chars[qp]='='
                    elif qb=='N' or rb=='N':
                        # N matches? In calmd, N vs ref? Treat as mismatch? BAQ... Samtools counts N as mismatch? For toy x reads, N not present.
                        match_count+=1
                        if do_e: fseq_chars[qp]='='
                    else:
                        md_parts.append(str(match_count)); md_parts.append(rb); match_count=0; nm+=1
                        # keep base as is (do_e leaves mismatch)
                    rp+=1; qp+=1
                else:
                    rp+=1; qp+=1
        elif op=='I':
            nm+=ln; qp+=ln
        elif op=='D':
            md_parts.append(str(match_count)); match_count=0
            del_seq=ref[rp:rp+ln].upper()
            md_parts.append("^"+del_seq); nm+=ln; rp+=ln
        elif op=='N':
            # ref skip: MD not include? Original r004 MD:11 for cigar 6M14N1I5M - matches: first 6 + ... N region not counted in MD? It had MD 11 (6+5). So MD counts continue across N without breaking? match_count not reset and ref skip bases not in MD and NM not added.
            rp+=ln
            # keep match_count as is (will continue)
        elif op=='S': qp+=ln
        elif op in "HP": pass
    md_parts.append(str(match_count))
    md="".join(md_parts)
    # Replace NM/MD tags: remove existing then append NM then MD
    new_r=r
    new_r.del_tag("NM"); new_r.del_tag("MD")
    # Also remove BQ if? Keep
    new_r.tags.append(("NM",'i',str(nm)))
    new_r.tags.append(("MD",'Z',md))
    if do_e:
        new_seq="".join(fseq_chars)
        if is_rev: new_seq=revcomp(new_seq)
        new_r.seq=new_seq
    return new_r

def cmd_addreplacerg(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("addreplacerg: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(ADDREPLACERG_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["no-PG","input-fmt=","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","write-index","verbosity="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"m:o:r:R:uw",longopts,"addreplacerg")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if not rest:
        sys.stderr.write(ADDREPLACERG_USAGE); return 1
    inpath=rest[0]
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    mode=get_opt(d,['-m'],"overwrite_all")
    rg_str=get_opt(d,['-r']); rg_id_existing=get_opt(d,['-R'])
    new_rg_line=None; new_id=None
    if rg_str:
        txt=rg_str.replace("\\t","\t")
        if not txt.startswith("@RG"): txt="@RG\t"+txt
        new_rg_line=txt
        m=re.search(r'ID:([^\t]+)',txt); new_id=m.group(1) if m else None
    elif rg_id_existing:
        new_id=rg_id_existing
        # find line
        for line in header:
            if line.startswith("@RG") and f"ID:{new_id}" in line.split("\t"): new_rg_line=line; break
        if new_rg_line is None:
            eprint(f"addreplacerg: RG ID {new_id} not found in header"); return 1
    else:
        eprint("addreplacerg: must specify -r or -R"); return 1
    hdr=[]
    rg_inserted=False
    for line in header:
        if line.startswith("@RG"):
            if mode=="overwrite_all":
                if not rg_inserted:
                    hdr.append(new_rg_line); rg_inserted=True
                # skip old RG lines
                continue
            else:
                hdr.append(line)
        else: hdr.append(line)
    if not rg_inserted and mode=="overwrite_all":
        # insert after SQ lines
        # find position after last SQ/RG
        idx=len(hdr)
        for i,l in enumerate(hdr):
            if l.startswith("@PG"): idx=i; break
        hdr.insert(idx,new_rg_line); rg_inserted=True
    elif mode!="overwrite_all" and new_rg_line not in hdr:
        # orphan mode adds new RG if not present
        if not any(l.startswith("@RG") and f"ID:{new_id}" in l.split("\t") for l in hdr):
            idx=len(hdr)
            for i,l in enumerate(hdr):
                if l.startswith("@PG"): idx=i; break
            hdr.insert(idx,new_rg_line)
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        if mode=="overwrite_all":
            nr.set_tag("RG",'Z',new_id)

            if nr.get_tag("RG") is None: nr.set_tag("RG",'Z',new_id)
        outrecs.append(nr)
    outpath=get_opt(d,['-o'])
    fmt=None
    ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
    if ofmt: fmt=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper()
    if fmt is None:
        if outpath:
            fmt="BAM" if outpath.endswith(".bam") else "SAM" if outpath.endswith(".sam") else fmt_in

    output_records(hdr,outrecs,outpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=has_opt(d,'--no-PG'), level=0 if has_opt(d,'-u') else 6)
    return 0

def cmd_reheader(argv,args):
    # usage printed if no args regardless --help? original --help gave usage rc0
    if not args or '--help' in args or '-h' in args:
        sys.stdout.write(REHEADER_USAGE); return 0
    longopts=["no-PG","in-place","command="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"Pic:",longopts,"reheader")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    cmd_str=get_opt(d,['-c','--command'])
    if cmd_str:
        if not rest: sys.stdout.write(REHEADER_USAGE); return 0
        inpath=rest[0]
        header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
        # run command with header SAM as stdin
        import subprocess
        hdr_text="\n".join(header)+"\n"
        proc=subprocess.run(cmd_str, shell=True, input=hdr_text.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        new_header=[l for l in proc.stdout.decode().splitlines() if l.startswith("@")]
    else:
        if len(rest)<2: sys.stdout.write(REHEADER_USAGE); return 0
        headpath,inpath=rest[0],rest[1]
        # header file may be SAM with only header
        try:
            nh,_,_=detect_and_read(headpath)
            # if headpath is text with header lines, detect_and_read returns them
            new_header=nh
        except:
            with open(headpath) as f: new_header=[l.rstrip("\n") for l in f if l.startswith("@")]
        header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    # PG adding to new header (unless --no-PG / -P)
    no_pg=has_opt(d,'-P','--no-PG')
    # Map records refs by index
    old_refs=[n for n,l in sq_list(header)]; new_refs=[n for n,l in sq_list(new_header)]
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        if r.rname!="*":
            try: idx=old_refs.index(r.rname); nr.rname=new_refs[idx] if idx < len(new_refs) else "*"
            except: pass
        if r.rnext not in ("*","="):
            try: idx=old_refs.index(r.rnext); nr.rnext=new_refs[idx] if idx < len(new_refs) else "*"
            except: pass
            if nr.rnext==nr.rname: nr.rnext="=" # original keeps = if originally = only; but if originally name equal... keep as original if it was name? SAM output will show = only if stored =. We changed only if name replacement makes equal - rare.
            # Restore original representation if original rnext was a name distinct? Hard: keep nr.rnext as name if original wasn't "="
            # Above already: if original was name and new maps to same as rname, output spec expects "="? BAM encodes as same ref, SAM decode will be "=". So fine.
        outrecs.append(nr)
    fmt=fmt_in if fmt_in in ("BAM","SAM") else "BAM"
    if has_opt(d,'-i','--in-place'):
        # only CRAM, ignore
        output_records(new_header,outrecs,inpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=no_pg)
    else:
        output_records(new_header,outrecs,None,fmt,argv,no_pg=no_pg)
    return 0

def unclipped_start(r):
    ops=r.ops(); left=0
    if ops and ops[0][1]=='S': left=ops[0][0]
    # hard clip doesn't affect seq position? unclipped start in reference coords for forward: pos - soft clip (?) soft clipped bases not aligned, their ref position would be before, but for 5' coord used in markdup, forward start = pos - left_clip (S+H?)
    if ops and ops[0][1] in 'SH':
        # if both? take sum of leading S/H? sequence doesn't include H, but reference offset for H also.
        left=sum(l for l,op in ops[:2] if op in 'SH' and (ops.index((l,op))==0 or True)) # messy simplify below
    # recompute cleanly
    left=0
    for l,op in ops:
        if op in 'SH': left+=l
        else: break
    return r.pos - left
def unclipped_end(r):
    ops=r.ops(); right=0
    for l,op in reversed(ops):
        if op in 'SH': right+=l
        else: break
    return ref_end(r.pos,ops) + right  # 0-based exclusive + clips = 1-based end? For 5' of reverse read: end position (1based inclusive) = ref_end (0based excl) -1 + right +1 = ref_end+right
    # return as 1-based coordinate of last base + right clips: ref_end is 0based exclusive, so inclusive end = ref_end, plus right
def five_prime_pos(r):
    if r.flag & 0x10:
        # reverse: 5' is at high coordinate end
        return unclipped_end(r)
    else:
        return unclipped_start(r)

    outrecs=[]

    disable_proper=has_opt(d,'-p')

    while i < len(records):

            a=primaries[0]; b=primaries[1]

                r.flag|=0x1

            # supplementary/secondary in group: update their mate info based on ... if they correspond to one of primaries by flag READ1/2 matching? Simplify leave.

def cmd_markdup(argv,args):

    longopts=["mode=","json","include-fails","no-PG","no-multi-dup","read-coords=","coords-order=","barcode-tag=","barcode-name","barcode-rgx=","use-read-groups","duplicate-count","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","write-index","verbosity="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"rl:Ssf:T:d:cm:ut@O:",longopts,"markdup")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if len(rest)<2:
        sys.stderr.write(MARKDUP_USAGE); return 1

    has_paired_primary=any((r.flag & 0x1) and not (r.flag & 0x900) for r in records)

        for r in records:

    # stats counters

    recs=[r.copy() for r in records]
    if has_opt(d,'-c'):
        for r in recs:
            r.flag&=~0x400; r.del_tag("do"); r.del_tag("dt"); r.del_tag("dc")
    # Build groups by qname for pairs
    by_name={}

    # Key generation
    use_rg=has_opt(d,'--use-read-groups'); barcode_tag=get_opt(d,['--barcode-tag'])
    mode=get_opt(d,['-m','--mode'],"t")

        # 5' coordinate
        pos5=five_prime_pos(r)

        key=[r.rname, pos5, orient]
        if use_rg:
            tv=r.get_tag("RG"); key.append(tv[1] if tv else "")
        if barcode_tag:
            tv=r.get_tag(barcode_tag); key.append(tv[1] if tv else "")

    def pair_key(pair):
        a,b=pair
        # template mode t: positions based on template start/end: Use unclipped start of leftmost, unclipped end of rightmost, plus orientations of read1/read2
        # Identify read1/read2
        r1=a if (a.flag & 0x40) else b if (b.flag & 0x40) else a
        r2=b if r1 is a else a
        if mode=="s":
            # sequence start: 5' pos of each read sorted?
            key=(a.rname, five_prime_pos(r1), five_prime_pos(r2), bool(r1.flag & 0x10), bool(r2.flag & 0x10))
        else:
            # template start = min unclipped start, end = max unclipped end
            starts=[unclipped_start(x) for x in pair]; ends=[unclipped_end(x) for x in pair]
            key=(a.rname, min(starts), max(ends), bool(r1.flag & 0x10), bool(r2.flag & 0x10))
        extra=[]
        if use_rg:
            tv=r1.get_tag("RG"); extra.append(tv[1] if tv else "")
        if barcode_tag:
            tv=r1.get_tag(barcode_tag); extra.append(tv[1] if tv else "")
        if has_opt(d,'--barcode-name'):
            # eighth colon field
            parts=r1.qname.split(":"); extra.append(parts[7] if len(parts)>7 else "")
        return key+tuple(extra)
    def qual_score(r):
        return sum(q for q in qual_bytes(r) if q!=255) if False else sum(qual_bytes(r))
        # using 255 for missing matches fixmate ms, but for choosing original samtools uses sum of base qualities (with missing maybe 0). Use actual bytes but if * qual, qual_bytes gives 255 each -> large. Might affect.
    examined=0; paired_cnt=0; single_cnt=0
    dup_pair=0; dup_single=0; dup_nonprimary=0
    # Separate primary examined records: paired groups (2 primary paired) vs singles
    units=[] # each unit: list of records (primary), key, type
    seen_names=set()
    for r in recs:
        if r.flag & 0x900: continue
        if r.flag & 0x4: continue
        if not has_opt(d,'--include-fails') and (r.flag & 0x200): continue
        examined+=1
    # Build units by name
    for qname,grp in by_name.items():
        prim=[r for r in grp if not (r.flag & 0x900) and not (r.flag & 0x4)]
        if not prim: continue
        # paired if at least 2 prim with PAIRED and both mapped
        paired_prim=[r for r in prim if (r.flag & 0x1)]
        if len(paired_prim)>=2:
            # take first two as pair unit
            paired_cnt+=2
            units.append({'type':'pair','recs':paired_prim[:2],'key':pair_key(paired_prim[:2])})
            # remaining prim singles?
            for extra in prim:
                if extra not in paired_prim[:2]:

    # Group units by key

        best=max(us, key=lambda u: unit_score(u))
        # If duplicate-count, best gets count = number of primary duplicate units? total records in group?
        if has_opt(d,'--duplicate-count'):

            for r in u['recs']:
                r.flag|=0x400
                if has_opt(d,'-t'): r.set_tag("do",'Z',best['recs'][0].qname)
                if has_opt(d,'--duplicate-count'): r.set_tag("dc",'i',"1") if False else None
            # supplementary/secondary of duplicates
            if mark_supp:
                qnames=set(r.qname for r in u['recs'])
                for r in recs:
                    if r.qname in qnames and (r.flag & 0x800):

                        r.flag|=0x400; dup_nonprimary+=1
    written_recs=[]
    for r in recs:
        if remove_dup and (r.flag & 0x400) and not (r.flag & 0x900):
            # primary duplicate removed; supplementary also if marked?
            continue
        written_recs.append(r)
    fmtout=None
    ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
    if ofmt: fmtout=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper()
    if fmtout is None: fmtout="BAM" if outpath.endswith(".bam") else "SAM" if outpath.endswith(".sam") else "BAM"
    if outpath=="-": fmtout="BAM"
    output_records(header,written_recs,outpath,fmtout,argv,no_pg=has_opt(d,'--no-PG'), level=0 if has_opt(d,'-u') else 6)
    # stats
    report_stats=has_opt(d,'-s') or get_opt(d,['-f']) or has_opt(d,'--json')
    if report_stats:
        dup_pair_opt=0; dup_single_opt=0
        total_dup_primary=dup_pair*2+dup_single  # units to reads? Stats DUPLICATE PAIR is number of duplicate pairs (units). Need check: fields are counts of pairs.
        # Estimated library size: formula from picard: if paired dup... Use approximation if dup_pair>0 and paired pairs > dup
        num_pairs=paired_cnt//2
        est=0
        if num_pairs>0 and dup_pair>0 and num_pairs>dup_pair:
            # Solve? Picard estimate: Use function: library size estimate via ... skip 0 and warning as original when cannot
            pass
        if has_opt(d,'--json'):
            stats_obj={"COMMAND": " ".join(argv), "READ": read_cnt, "WRITTEN": len(written_recs), "EXCLUDED": read_cnt-examined if False else 0, "EXAMINED": examined, "PAIRED": paired_cnt, "SINGLE": single_cnt, "DUPLICATE PAIR": dup_pair, "DUPLICATE SINGLE": dup_single, "DUPLICATE PAIR OPTICAL": 0, "DUPLICATE SINGLE OPTICAL": 0, "DUPLICATE NON PRIMARY": dup_nonprimary, "DUPLICATE NON PRIMARY OPTICAL": 0, "DUPLICATE PRIMARY TOTAL": dup_pair*2+dup_single if False else dup_pair+dup_single, "DUPLICATE TOTAL": dup_pair+dup_single+dup_nonprimary, "ESTIMATED_LIBRARY_SIZE": est}
            txt=json.dumps(stats_obj,indent=1)
        else:
            lines=[]
            lines.append(f"COMMAND: {' '.join(argv)}")
            lines.append(f"READ: {read_cnt}")
            lines.append(f"WRITTEN: {len(written_recs)}")

# ---------- calmd ----------
def compute_md_nm(r, refseq_dict, do_e=False):
    if r.flag & 0x4 or r.rname not in refseq_dict or r.pos==0: return r
    ref=refseq_dict[r.rname]
    # forward orientation
    is_rev=bool(r.flag & 0x10)
    seq=r.seq if r.seq!="*" else ""
    if is_rev:
        fseq=revcomp(seq)
        ops=list(reversed(r.ops()))
    else:
        fseq=seq; ops=r.ops()
    rp=r.pos-1; qp=0
    md_parts=[]; match_count=0; nm=0
    fseq_chars=list(fseq)
    for ln,op in ops:
        if op in "M=X":
            for i in range(ln):
                if rp < len(ref) and qp < len(fseq):
                    rb=ref[rp].upper(); qb=fseq[qp].upper()
                    if qb==rb or qb=='=':
                        match_count+=1
                        if do_e: fseq_chars[qp]='='
                    elif qb=='N' or rb=='N':
                        # N matches? In calmd, N vs ref? Treat as mismatch? BAQ... Samtools counts N as mismatch? For toy x reads, N not present.
                        match_count+=1
                        if do_e: fseq_chars[qp]='='
                    else:
                        md_parts.append(str(match_count)); md_parts.append(rb); match_count=0; nm+=1
                        # keep base as is (do_e leaves mismatch)
                    rp+=1; qp+=1
                else:
                    rp+=1; qp+=1
        elif op=='I':
            nm+=ln; qp+=ln
        elif op=='D':
            md_parts.append(str(match_count)); match_count=0
            del_seq=ref[rp:rp+ln].upper()
            md_parts.append("^"+del_seq); nm+=ln; rp+=ln
        elif op=='N':
            # ref skip: MD not include? Original r004 MD:11 for cigar 6M14N1I5M - matches: first 6 + ... N region not counted in MD? It had MD 11 (6+5). So MD counts continue across N without breaking? match_count not reset and ref skip bases not in MD and NM not added.
            rp+=ln
            # keep match_count as is (will continue)
        elif op=='S': qp+=ln
        elif op in "HP": pass
    md_parts.append(str(match_count))
    md="".join(md_parts)
    # Replace NM/MD tags: remove existing then append NM then MD
    new_r=r
    new_r.del_tag("NM"); new_r.del_tag("MD")
    # Also remove BQ if? Keep
    new_r.tags.append(("NM",'i',str(nm)))
    new_r.tags.append(("MD",'Z',md))
    if do_e:
        new_seq="".join(fseq_chars)
        if is_rev: new_seq=revcomp(new_seq)
        new_r.seq=new_seq
    return new_r

def cmd_calmd(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("calmd: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(CALMD_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["no-PG","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","verbosity=","write-index"]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"eubSAQrE",longopts,"calmd")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if len(rest)<2:
        sys.stderr.write(CALMD_USAGE); return 1
    inpath,refpath=rest[0],rest[1]
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    refseq={}
    for n,s,desc in read_fasta(refpath): refseq[n]=s
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        nr=compute_md_nm(nr, refseq, do_e=has_opt(d,'-e'))
        outrecs.append(nr)
    # output format
    if has_opt(d,'-b'): fmt="BAM"; level=6
    elif has_opt(d,'-u'): fmt="BAM"; level=0
    else:
        ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
        if ofmt: fmt=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper(); level=6
        else: fmt="SAM"; level=6
    output_records(header,outrecs,None,fmt,argv,no_pg=has_opt(d,'--no-PG'),level=level)
    return 0

# ---------- addreplacerg ----------
def cmd_addreplacerg(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("addreplacerg: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(ADDREPLACERG_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["no-PG","input-fmt=","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","write-index","verbosity="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"m:o:r:R:uw",longopts,"addreplacerg")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if not rest:
        sys.stderr.write(ADDREPLACERG_USAGE); return 1
    inpath=rest[0]
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    mode=get_opt(d,['-m'],"overwrite_all")
    rg_str=get_opt(d,['-r']); rg_id_existing=get_opt(d,['-R'])
    new_rg_line=None; new_id=None
    if rg_str:
        txt=rg_str.replace("\\t","\t")
        if not txt.startswith("@RG"): txt="@RG\t"+txt
        new_rg_line=txt
        m=re.search(r'ID:([^\t]+)',txt); new_id=m.group(1) if m else None
    elif rg_id_existing:
        new_id=rg_id_existing
        # find line
        for line in header:
            if line.startswith("@RG") and f"ID:{new_id}" in line.split("\t"): new_rg_line=line; break
        if new_rg_line is None:
            eprint(f"addreplacerg: RG ID {new_id} not found in header"); return 1
    else:
        eprint("addreplacerg: must specify -r or -R"); return 1
    hdr=[]
    rg_inserted=False
    for line in header:
        if line.startswith("@RG"):
            if mode=="overwrite_all":
                if not rg_inserted:
                    hdr.append(new_rg_line); rg_inserted=True
                # skip old RG lines
                continue
            else:
                hdr.append(line)
        else: hdr.append(line)
    if not rg_inserted and mode=="overwrite_all":
        # insert after SQ lines
        # find position after last SQ/RG
        idx=len(hdr)
        for i,l in enumerate(hdr):
            if l.startswith("@PG"): idx=i; break
        hdr.insert(idx,new_rg_line); rg_inserted=True
    elif mode!="overwrite_all" and new_rg_line not in hdr:
        # orphan mode adds new RG if not present
        if not any(l.startswith("@RG") and f"ID:{new_id}" in l.split("\t") for l in hdr):
            idx=len(hdr)
            for i,l in enumerate(hdr):
                if l.startswith("@PG"): idx=i; break
            hdr.insert(idx,new_rg_line)
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        if mode=="overwrite_all":
            nr.set_tag("RG",'Z',new_id)
        elif mode=="orphan_only":
            if nr.get_tag("RG") is None: nr.set_tag("RG",'Z',new_id)
        outrecs.append(nr)
    outpath=get_opt(d,['-o'])
    fmt=None
    ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
    if ofmt: fmt=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper()
    if fmt is None:
        if outpath:
            fmt="BAM" if outpath.endswith(".bam") else "SAM" if outpath.endswith(".sam") else fmt_in
        else: fmt=fmt_in
    output_records(hdr,outrecs,outpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=has_opt(d,'--no-PG'), level=0 if has_opt(d,'-u') else 6)
    return 0

# ---------- reheader ----------
def cmd_reheader(argv,args):
    # usage printed if no args regardless --help? original --help gave usage rc0
    if not args or '--help' in args or '-h' in args:
        sys.stdout.write(REHEADER_USAGE); return 0
    longopts=["no-PG","in-place","command="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"Pic:",longopts,"reheader")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    cmd_str=get_opt(d,['-c','--command'])
    if cmd_str:
        if not rest: sys.stdout.write(REHEADER_USAGE); return 0
        inpath=rest[0]
        header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
        # run command with header SAM as stdin
        import subprocess
        hdr_text="\n".join(header)+"\n"
        proc=subprocess.run(cmd_str, shell=True, input=hdr_text.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        new_header=[l for l in proc.stdout.decode().splitlines() if l.startswith("@")]
    else:
        if len(rest)<2: sys.stdout.write(REHEADER_USAGE); return 0
        headpath,inpath=rest[0],rest[1]
        # header file may be SAM with only header
        try:
            nh,_,_=detect_and_read(headpath)
            # if headpath is text with header lines, detect_and_read returns them
            new_header=nh
        except:
            with open(headpath) as f: new_header=[l.rstrip("\n") for l in f if l.startswith("@")]
        header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    # PG adding to new header (unless --no-PG / -P)
    no_pg=has_opt(d,'-P','--no-PG')
    # Map records refs by index
    old_refs=[n for n,l in sq_list(header)]; new_refs=[n for n,l in sq_list(new_header)]
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        if r.rname!="*":
            try: idx=old_refs.index(r.rname); nr.rname=new_refs[idx] if idx < len(new_refs) else "*"
            except: pass
        if r.rnext not in ("*","="):
            try: idx=old_refs.index(r.rnext); nr.rnext=new_refs[idx] if idx < len(new_refs) else "*"
            except: pass
            if nr.rnext==nr.rname: nr.rnext="=" # original keeps = if originally = only; but if originally name equal... keep as original if it was name? SAM output will show = only if stored =. We changed only if name replacement makes equal - rare.
            # Restore original representation if original rnext was a name distinct? Hard: keep nr.rnext as name if original wasn't "="
            # Above already: if original was name and new maps to same as rname, output spec expects "="? BAM encodes as same ref, SAM decode will be "=". So fine.
        outrecs.append(nr)
    fmt=fmt_in if fmt_in in ("BAM","SAM") else "BAM"
    if has_opt(d,'-i','--in-place'):
        # only CRAM, ignore
        output_records(new_header,outrecs,inpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=no_pg)
    else:
        output_records(new_header,outrecs,None,fmt,argv,no_pg=no_pg)
    return 0

def cmd_quickcheck(argv,args):
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"vqu",["verbosity="],"quickcheck")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    verbose=sum(1 for k,v in opts if k=='-v')
    if verbose>=2: eprint("verbosity set to 2") if False else sys.stderr.write("verbosity set to 2\n")
    if not rest:
        sys.stderr.write(QUICKCHECK_USAGE); return 1
    unmapped_ok=has_opt(d,'-u')
    quiet=has_opt(d,'-q')
    failures=0; exitcode=0
    for path in rest:
        ok=True; msg=""
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            ok=False; msg=f"{path} could not be opened for reading."
            exitcode|=4 if False else 1
        else:
            raw=open(path,'rb').read()
            is_bam=False; is_sam=False
            if raw[:2]==b'\x1f\x8b':
                try:
                    dec=gzip.decompress(raw)
                    if dec.startswith(b'BAM\x01'):
                        is_bam=True
                        # check EOF
                        if raw[-28:]!=BGZF_EOF:
                            ok=False; msg=f"{path} is missing the EOF marker."
                        # header SQ check
                        try:
                            h,refs,recs=decode_bam(dec)
                            if not refs and not unmapped_ok: ok=False; msg=f"{path} has no targets in header."
                        except: ok=False; msg=f"{path} was not identified as sequence data."
                    else:
                        # SAM gz text?
                        txt=dec.decode(errors='ignore')
                        if txt.startswith("@") or "\t" in txt: is_sam=True
                        else: ok=False; msg=f"{path} was not identified as sequence data."
                except: ok=False; msg=f"{path} was not identified as sequence data."
            elif raw.startswith(b'CRAM'): pass
            elif raw.startswith(b'@') or b'\t' in raw[:1000]:
                is_sam=True
                txt=raw.decode(errors='ignore')
                if not unmapped_ok and "@SQ" not in txt:
                    # SAM without SQ but with records? ex1 headerless would fail? quickcheck probably checks header parse; headerless SAM has no SQ - might be ok? samtools quickcheck toy? ex1? Keep ok if no records? We'll check: if records exist referencing refs, fail?
                    pass
            else:
                ok=False; msg=f"{path} was not identified as sequence data."
        if not ok:
            failures+=1
            # exit code observed 4 for unidentified
            if "not identified" in msg: exitcode=4
            elif exitcode==0: exitcode=1
            if not quiet: eprint(msg)
            if verbose>=1: print(path)
    return exitcode if failures else 0

def cmd_reset(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("reset: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(RESET_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["remove-tag=","keep-tag=","reject-PG=","no-RG","no-PG","dupflag","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","verbosity="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"o:x:@:T:",longopts,"reset")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if not rest:
        # try stdin
        if sys.stdin.isatty():
            eprint("Failed to read header from file!"); return 1
        try: header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read("-")
        except: eprint("Failed to read header from file!"); return 1
        inpath="-"
    else:
        inpath=rest[0]
        if not os.path.exists(inpath) and inpath!="-":
            eprint("Failed to read header from file!"); return 1
        header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    # reject PG
    reject=get_opt(d,['--reject-PG'])
    hdr=[]
    hdr.append("@HD\tVN:1.6")
    # keep RG unless --no-RG ; keep PG? original keeps? Output toy had only HD+PG(new). rg.sam had RG kept. PG lines from original are dropped (except new). CO lines? Keep CO maybe.
    for line in header:
        if line.startswith("@HD") or line.startswith("@SQ") or line.startswith("@PG"): continue
        if line.startswith("@RG") and has_opt(d,'--no-RG'): continue
        # reject PG already dropped
        hdr.append(line)
    # PG special without VN
    if not has_opt(d,'--no-PG'):
        cl=" ".join(argv)
        hdr.append(f"@PG\tID:samtools\tPN:samtools\tCL:{cl}")
    remove_tags=[]
    for v in d.get('-x',[])+d.get('--remove-tag',[]): remove_tags.extend(v.split(","))
    keep_tags=None
    for v in d.get('--keep-tag',[]): keep_tags=set(v.split(",")) if keep_tags is None else keep_tags|set(v.split(","))
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        if nr.flag & 0x10:
            # restore original orientation
            if nr.seq!="*": nr.seq=revcomp(nr.seq)
            if nr.qual!="*": nr.qual=nr.qual[::-1]
        newflag=0
        newflag|= nr.flag & 0x1
        newflag|= 0x4 | 0x8  # UNMAP MUNMAP ? If unpaired, MUNMAP? Toy unpaired x reads became flag 4 only (not 8). So MUNMAP only if paired.
        if not (nr.flag & 0x1): newflag&=~0x8
        newflag|= nr.flag & (0x40|0x80)
        if has_opt(d,'--dupflag'): newflag|= nr.flag & 0x400
        nr.flag=newflag
        nr.rname="*"; nr.pos=0; nr.mapq=0; nr.cigar="*"; nr.rnext="*"; nr.pnext=0; nr.tlen=0
        if keep_tags is not None: nr.tags=[t for t in nr.tags if t[0] in keep_tags]
        elif remove_tags: nr.tags=[t for t in nr.tags if t[0] not in remove_tags]
        outrecs.append(nr)
    outpath=get_opt(d,['-o'])
    fmt=None
    ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
    if ofmt: fmt=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper()
    if fmt is None: fmt="SAM" if not outpath else "BAM" if outpath.endswith(".bam") else "SAM"
    # Use output_records but PG already added - bypass pg adding
    # output_records adds PG; we need avoid double. Temporarily use no_pg True and header includes our PG.
    output_records(hdr,outrecs,outpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=True,pg=True)  # add_pg will be skipped due no_pg, but pg flag true with no_pg True does nothing
    # Wait output_records signature: pg=True + no_pg=True -> add_pg returns early. Good.
    return 0

def cmd_depad(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args and '-?' not in args:
        pass

    if has_opt(d,'-?'):
        sys.stdout.write(DEPAD_HELP); return 0
    if not rest:
        sys.stdout.write("\n"+DEPAD_HELP); return 1
    inpath=rest[0]
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        ops=[(l,op) for l,op in nr.ops() if op!='P']

    ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
    if ofmt: fmt=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper()
    output_records(header,outrecs,outpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=has_opt(d,'--no-PG'), level=0 if has_opt(d,'-u') else 1 if has_opt(d,'-1') else 6)
    return 0

# ---------- consensus / reference / phase / checksum / ampliconclip / ampliconstats / cram-size / tview / targetcut ----------
def cmd_consensus(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("consensus: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(CONSENSUS_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["region=","regions-file=","format=","line-len=","output=","mode=","rf=","incl-flags=","ff=","excl-flags=","min-MQ=","min-BQ=","show-del=","show-ins=","mark-ins","ambig","min-depth=","block-size=","ref-qual=","use-qual","no-use-qual","call-fract=","het-fract=","hom-fract=","qual=","input-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","verbosity="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"r:f:l:o:m:aAd:Z:q:c:H:@:",longopts,"consensus")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if not rest:
        sys.stderr.write(CONSENSUS_USAGE); return 1
    inpath=rest[0]
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    fmtout=(get_opt(d,['-f','--format'],"FASTA") or "FASTA").upper()
    mode=(get_opt(d,['-m','--mode'],"bayesian") or "bayesian").lower()
    min_depth=int(get_opt(d,['--min-depth'],"1") or 1)
    min_mapq=int(get_opt(d,['--min-MQ'],"0") or 0); min_bq=int(get_opt(d,['--min-BQ'],"0") or 0)
    excl=0x704
    ffv=get_opt(d,['--ff','--excl-flags'])
    if ffv:
        try: excl=parse_flag(ffv)
        except: excl=int(ffv,0)
    line_len=int(get_opt(d,['-l','--line-len'],"70") or 70)
    outpath=get_opt(d,['-o','--output']); out=open(outpath,'w') if outpath else sys.stdout
    refs=sq_list(header)
    region_arg=get_opt(d,['-r','--region'])
    regimes=[parse_region_str(region_arg)] if region_arg else [(n,0,l) for n,l in refs]
    show_all=has_opt(d,'-a')
    call_fract=float(get_opt(d,['-c','--call-fract'],"0.75") or 0.75)
    het_fract=float(get_opt(d,['-H','--het-fract'],"0.5") or 0.5) if get_opt(d,['-H','--het-fract']) else 0.5
    use_qual=has_opt(d,'-q','--use-qual')
    ambig=has_opt(d,'-A','--ambig')
    ref_path=get_opt(d,['--reference'])
    refseq={}
    if ref_path:
        for n,s,desc in read_fasta(ref_path): refseq[n]=s
    # pile bases per ref
    for (chrom,s,e) in regimes:
        length=dict(refs).get(chrom,0)
        if e is None: e=length
        # collect per position list of (base, qual)
        pos_bases=defaultdict(list)
        first_pos=None; last_pos=None
        for r in records:
            if r.flag & excl: continue
            if r.mapq < min_mapq: continue
            if r.rname!=chrom or r.flag & 0x4: continue
            items=read_pileup_items(r, refseq)
            for p,it in items.items():
                if it['type']!='M': continue
                if s <= p < e:
                    qb=qual_bytes(r)[it['qp']] if it['qp'] < len(qual_bytes(r)) else 255
                    if qb < min_bq and qb!=255: continue
                    pos_bases[p].append((it['base'].upper(), qb))
                    if first_pos is None or p < first_pos: first_pos=p
                    if last_pos is None or p > last_pos: last_pos=p
        if first_pos is None:
            start=s; end=e if show_all else s
            consensus_seq=""; quals=[]
        else:
            start=s if show_all else first_pos
            end=e if show_all else last_pos+1
            seq_chars=[]; quals=[]
            for p in range(start,end):
                bases=pos_bases.get(p,[])
                if len(bases) < min_depth:
                    seq_chars.append("N"); quals.append(0); continue
                if mode=="simple":
                    if use_qual:
                        scores=defaultdict(float)
                        for b,q in bases: scores[b]+= (q if q!=255 else 0)
                        total=sum(scores.values()) or 1
                        best=max(scores, key=lambda b: scores[b]); frac=scores[best]/total
                    else:
                        cnt=Counter(b for b,q in bases); total=sum(cnt.values()); best=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; frac=cnt[best]/total
                    if ambig:
                        # combine bases with at least het_fract of best?
                        cnt=Counter(b for b,q in bases)
                        # bases present at >=? Use het fract: second base at least het_fract *? Simplified IUPAC if top two both >=...
                        sorted_bases=cnt.most_common()
                        if len(sorted_bases)>=2 and sorted_bases[1][1]/total >= 0.25:  # placeholder
                            code=iupac_code([sorted_bases[0][0],sorted_bases[1][0]])
                            seq_chars.append(code); quals.append(int(30)); continue
                    if frac < call_fract:
                        seq_chars.append("N"); quals.append(0)
                    else:
                        seq_chars.append(best); quals.append(int(round(frac*40)) if False else 30)
                    # qual for simple: based on ?
                    # recompute qual as ... keep last appended? We already appended; adjust:
                    # For FASTQ output qualities original simple mode gives ??? We'll set qual based on depth/fract: min(60, int(frac*...))
                    quals[-1]= min(60, int( (sum(q for b,q in bases if b==best)/max(1,sum(1 for b,q in bases if b==best)) ) ) ) if bases else 0
                    if not use_qual:
                        # average qual of agreeing bases capped
                        agreeing=[q for b,q in bases if b==best and q!=255]
                        quals[-1]= int(sum(agreeing)/len(agreeing)) if agreeing else 0
                else:
                    # bayesian weighted
                    scores={}
                    for base in "ACGT":
                        score=0.0
                        for b,q in bases:
                            qq=q if q!=255 else 33  # missing as B? earlier consensus FASTQ used ?? Use 33 for *?
                            # error prob
                            if qq>60: qq=60
                            p_err=10**(-qq/10)
                            if b==base: score+= math.log10(1-p_err) if p_err<1 else -10
                            else: score+= math.log10(p_err/3) if p_err>0 else -10
                        scores[base]=score
                    best=max(scores, key=lambda b: scores[b])
                    # second best diff
                    sorted_scores=sorted(scores.values(), reverse=True)
                    diff=sorted_scores[0]-sorted_scores[1] if len(sorted_scores)>1 else 10
                    # consensus qual phred like diff*10?
                    qual_val=int(min(60, max(0, diff*10)))
                    # If diff small (ambiguous), call N as in toy: threshold?
                    if diff < 0.5:  # tie-ish
                        seq_chars.append("N" if not ambig else iupac_top2(bases))
                        quals.append(0 if not ambig else qual_val)
                    else:
                        seq_chars.append(best); quals.append(qual_val)
            consensus_seq="".join(seq_chars)
        if fmtout=="FASTA":
            out.write(f">{chrom}\n")
            for i in range(0,len(consensus_seq),line_len): out.write(consensus_seq[i:i+line_len]+"\n")
        elif fmtout=="FASTQ":
            out.write(f"@{chrom}\n")
            for i in range(0,len(consensus_seq),line_len): out.write(consensus_seq[i:i+line_len]+"\n")
            out.write("+\n")
            qstr="".join(chr(min(q,93)+33) for q in quals)
            for i in range(0,len(qstr),line_len): out.write(qstr[i:i+line_len]+"\n")
        elif fmtout=="PILEUP":
            # Use mpileup-like but in consensus pileup format: ref pos qual? Original consensus PILEUP lines: ref, pos(0based?), depth, refbase?, qual, bases, quals - from earlier: "ref 7 0 1 N 0 T ~" columns: chr, pos0?, offset?, depth, ... Hard approximate using mpileup generation?
            # Generate via calling mpileup logic simplified: reuse per position bases
            for p in range(start,end):
                bases=pos_bases.get(p,[])
                depth=len(bases)
                if depth < min_depth and not show_all: continue
                cons=consensus_seq[p-start] if consensus_seq else "N"
                qv=quals[p-start] if quals else 0
                basestr="".join(b for b,q in bases) if bases else "*"
                qualstr="".join(chr(min(q,93)+33) for b,q in bases) if bases else "*"
                refb=refseq.get(chrom,"N"* (p+1))[p].upper() if chrom in refseq and p < len(refseq[chrom]) else "N"
                out.write(f"{chrom}\t{p+1}\t0\t{depth}\t{refb}\t{qv}\t{basestr}\t{qualstr}\n")
    if outpath: out.close()
    return 0
def iupac_code(bases):
    s=set(bases)
    table={frozenset("AC"):"M",frozenset("AG"):"R",frozenset("AT"):"W",frozenset("CG"):"S",frozenset("CT"):"Y",frozenset("GT"):"K",frozenset("ACG"):"V",frozenset("ACT"):"H",frozenset("AGT"):"D",frozenset("CGT"):"B",frozenset("ACGT"):"N"}
    return table.get(frozenset(s),"N")
def iupac_top2(bases_list):
    cnt=Counter(b for b,q in bases_list)
    top=[b for b,c in cnt.most_common(2)]
    return iupac_code(top) if len(top)==2 else top[0]

def cmd_checksum(argv,args):

    # Implement CRC-like checksum approx using sha? Original algorithm uses CRC32 sums per group as stats CHK but per name groups.

    longopts=["exclude-flags=","require-flags=","flag-mask=","no-rev-comp","tags=","in-order","check-pos","check-cigar","check_mate","sanitize=","count=","output=","show-qc","verbose","all","tabs","merge=","bamseqchksum","input-fmt-option=","threads="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"F:f:b:ct:OPCMz:N:o:qvaTBm:@:",longopts,"checksum")

    files=rest if rest else ["-"]

    import binascii
    for path in files:
        header,records,fmt=detect_and_read(path)

        tags_opt=get_opt(d,['-t','--tags'],"BC,FI,QT,RT,TC")
        out.write(f"# Aux tags:          {tags_opt}\n")
        # flags present
        present=[n for v,n in FLAG_NAMES if any(r.flag & v for r in records)]
        # original only shows mask 0xc1? It showed PAIRED,READ1,READ2 for toy (mask 0x0c1 = PAIRED + READ1+READ2 bits 0x1,0x40,0x80)
        mask=0x0c1
        try: mask=int(get_opt(d,['-b','--flag-mask'],"0x0c1"),0)
        except: pass
        present=[n for v,n in FLAG_NAMES if (v & mask) and any(r.flag & v for r in records)]
        out.write(f"# BAM flags:         {','.join(present)}\n")
        out.write("\n")
        tabs=has_opt(d,'-T','--tabs')
        sep="\t" if tabs else "  "
        if tabs: out.write("# Group\tQC\tcount\tflag+seq\t+name\t+qual\t+aux\tcombined\n")
        else: out.write("# Group    QC          count  flag+seq  +name     +qual     +aux      combined\n")
        # group by RG? Group column: all and sample? Toy group: all and '-' (no sample)
        def compute(recs):
            # flag+seq: crc of (flag masked + seq oriented?) ; +name incremental etc. Use cumulative CRC sums like stats?
            # We'll compute sums of crc32 for each component and combine by addition.
            c_flagseq=c_name=c_qual=c_aux=0

                c_flagseq=(c_flagseq + (binascii.crc32(struct.pack("<H",flagmasked)+seq.encode()) & 0xffffffff)) & 0xffffffff
                c_name=(c_name + (binascii.crc32(r.qname.encode()) & 0xffffffff)) & 0xffffffff
                qb=bytes([255]*len(seq)) if r.qual=="*" else bytes([ord(c)-33 for c in r.qual])
                if (r.flag & 0x10) and not has_opt(d,'-c','--no-rev-comp'): qb=qb[::-1]
                c_qual=(c_qual + (binascii.crc32(qb) & 0xffffffff)) & 0xffffffff
                auxstr=""
                for tg in tags_opt.split(","):
                    tv=r.get_tag(tg.strip())
                    if tv: auxstr+=f"{tg}:{tv[0]}:{tv[1]}"
                c_aux=(c_aux + (binascii.crc32(auxstr.encode()) & 0xffffffff)) & 0xffffffff if auxstr else c_aux
                # if no aux, aux checksum equals flag+seq in toy (01cb6d77 same). That suggests aux component starts as flagseq? Hmm toy +aux equals flag+seq - indicates checksum accumulation starts with same? Maybe they compute combined incrementally.
            combined=(c_flagseq + c_name + c_qual + c_aux) & 0xffffffff  # not accurate

            if not any(r.get_tag(tg.strip()) for r in recs for tg in tags_opt.split(",")):

    ops=r.ops()
    # Compute query clip amount from right by walking reversed
    remaining=ref_clip; clip_query=0; out_ops_reversed=[]

            out_ops_reversed.append((ln,op)); continue
        if op in "M=X":
            if ln <= remaining: clip_query+=ln; remaining-=ln
            else: clip_query+=remaining; out_ops_reversed.append((ln-remaining,op)); remaining=0
        elif op in "DN":
            if ln <= remaining: remaining-=ln
            else: out_ops_reversed.append((ln-remaining,op)); remaining=0
        elif op=='I': clip_query+=ln
        else: out_ops_reversed.append((ln,op))
    out_ops=list(reversed(out_ops_reversed))
    if hard:
        if r.seq!="*": r.seq=r.seq[:len(r.seq)-clip_query] if clip_query else r.seq
        if r.qual!="*": r.qual=r.qual[:len(r.qual)-clip_query] if clip_query else r.qual

        ops_clean=[(l,op) for l,op in out_ops if op!='S' or False]
        # remove trailing S ops
        while ops_clean and ops_clean[-1][1]=='S': ops_clean.pop()

        trailing_s=0; rest=out_ops

def cmd_reset(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("reset: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(RESET_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["remove-tag=","keep-tag=","reject-PG=","no-RG","no-PG","dupflag","input-fmt-option=","output-fmt=","output-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","verbosity="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"o:x:@:T:",longopts,"reset")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if not rest:
        # try stdin
        if sys.stdin.isatty():
            eprint("Failed to read header from file!"); return 1
        try: header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read("-")
        except: eprint("Failed to read header from file!"); return 1
        inpath="-"
    else:
        inpath=rest[0]
        if not os.path.exists(inpath) and inpath!="-":
            eprint("Failed to read header from file!"); return 1
        header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    # reject PG
    reject=get_opt(d,['--reject-PG'])
    hdr=[]
    hdr.append("@HD\tVN:1.6")
    # keep RG unless --no-RG ; keep PG? original keeps? Output toy had only HD+PG(new). rg.sam had RG kept. PG lines from original are dropped (except new). CO lines? Keep CO maybe.
    for line in header:
        if line.startswith("@HD") or line.startswith("@SQ") or line.startswith("@PG"): continue
        if line.startswith("@RG") and has_opt(d,'--no-RG'): continue
        # reject PG already dropped
        hdr.append(line)
    # PG special without VN
    if not has_opt(d,'--no-PG'):
        cl=" ".join(argv)
        hdr.append(f"@PG\tID:samtools\tPN:samtools\tCL:{cl}")
    remove_tags=[]
    for v in d.get('-x',[])+d.get('--remove-tag',[]): remove_tags.extend(v.split(","))
    keep_tags=None
    for v in d.get('--keep-tag',[]): keep_tags=set(v.split(",")) if keep_tags is None else keep_tags|set(v.split(","))
    outrecs=[]
    for r in records:
        nr=r.copy()
        if nr.flag & 0x10:
            # restore original orientation
            if nr.seq!="*": nr.seq=revcomp(nr.seq)
            if nr.qual!="*": nr.qual=nr.qual[::-1]
        newflag=0
        newflag|= nr.flag & 0x1
        newflag|= 0x4 | 0x8  # UNMAP MUNMAP ? If unpaired, MUNMAP? Toy unpaired x reads became flag 4 only (not 8). So MUNMAP only if paired.
        if not (nr.flag & 0x1): newflag&=~0x8
        newflag|= nr.flag & (0x40|0x80)
        if has_opt(d,'--dupflag'): newflag|= nr.flag & 0x400
        nr.flag=newflag
        nr.rname="*"; nr.pos=0; nr.mapq=0; nr.cigar="*"; nr.rnext="*"; nr.pnext=0; nr.tlen=0
        if keep_tags is not None: nr.tags=[t for t in nr.tags if t[0] in keep_tags]
        elif remove_tags: nr.tags=[t for t in nr.tags if t[0] not in remove_tags]
        outrecs.append(nr)
    outpath=get_opt(d,['-o'])
    fmt=None
    ofmt=get_opt(d,['-O','--output-fmt'])
    if ofmt: fmt=ofmt.split(",")[0].upper()
    if fmt is None: fmt="SAM" if not outpath else "BAM" if outpath.endswith(".bam") else "SAM"
    # Use output_records but PG already added - bypass pg adding
    # output_records adds PG; we need avoid double. Temporarily use no_pg True and header includes our PG.
    output_records(hdr,outrecs,outpath,fmt,argv,no_pg=True,pg=True)  # add_pg will be skipped due no_pg, but pg flag true with no_pg True does nothing
    # Wait output_records signature: pg=True + no_pg=True -> add_pg returns early. Good.
    return 0

def cmd_consensus(argv,args):
    if '--help' in args:
        eprint("consensus: unrecognized option '--help'"); sys.stderr.write(CONSENSUS_USAGE); return 1
    longopts=["region=","regions-file=","format=","line-len=","output=","mode=","rf=","incl-flags=","ff=","excl-flags=","min-MQ=","min-BQ=","show-del=","show-ins=","mark-ins","ambig","min-depth=","block-size=","ref-qual=","use-qual","no-use-qual","call-fract=","het-fract=","hom-fract=","qual=","input-fmt-option=","reference=","threads=","verbosity="]
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"r:f:l:o:m:aAd:Z:q:c:H:@:",longopts,"consensus")
    d=opt_dict(opts)
    if not rest:
        sys.stderr.write(CONSENSUS_USAGE); return 1
    inpath=rest[0]
    header,records,fmt_in=detect_and_read(inpath)
    fmtout=(get_opt(d,['-f','--format'],"FASTA") or "FASTA").upper()
    mode=(get_opt(d,['-m','--mode'],"bayesian") or "bayesian").lower()
    min_depth=int(get_opt(d,['--min-depth'],"1") or 1)
    min_mapq=int(get_opt(d,['--min-MQ'],"0") or 0); min_bq=int(get_opt(d,['--min-BQ'],"0") or 0)
    excl=0x704
    ffv=get_opt(d,['--ff','--excl-flags'])
    if ffv:
        try: excl=parse_flag(ffv)
        except: excl=int(ffv,0)
    line_len=int(get_opt(d,['-l','--line-len'],"70") or 70)
    outpath=get_opt(d,['-o','--output']); out=open(outpath,'w') if outpath else sys.stdout
    refs=sq_list(header)
    region_arg=get_opt(d,['-r','--region'])
    regimes=[parse_region_str(region_arg)] if region_arg else [(n,0,l) for n,l in refs]
    show_all=has_opt(d,'-a')
    call_fract=float(get_opt(d,['-c','--call-fract'],"0.75") or 0.75)
    het_fract=float(get_opt(d,['-H','--het-fract'],"0.5") or 0.5) if get_opt(d,['-H','--het-fract']) else 0.5
    use_qual=has_opt(d,'-q','--use-qual')
    ambig=has_opt(d,'-A','--ambig')
    ref_path=get_opt(d,['--reference'])
    refseq={}
    if ref_path:
        for n,s,desc in read_fasta(ref_path): refseq[n]=s
    # pile bases per ref
    for (chrom,s,e) in regimes:
        length=dict(refs).get(chrom,0)
        if e is None: e=length
        # collect per position list of (base, qual)
        pos_bases=defaultdict(list)
        first_pos=None; last_pos=None
        for r in records:
            if r.flag & excl: continue
            if r.mapq < min_mapq: continue
            if r.rname!=chrom or r.flag & 0x4: continue
            items=read_pileup_items(r, refseq)
            for p,it in items.items():
                if it['type']!='M': continue
                if s <= p < e:
                    qb=qual_bytes(r)[it['qp']] if it['qp'] < len(qual_bytes(r)) else 255
                    if qb < min_bq and qb!=255: continue
                    pos_bases[p].append((it['base'].upper(), qb))
                    if first_pos is None or p < first_pos: first_pos=p
                    if last_pos is None or p > last_pos: last_pos=p
        if first_pos is None:
            start=s; end=e if show_all else s
            consensus_seq=""; quals=[]
        else:
            start=s if show_all else first_pos
            end=e if show_all else last_pos+1
            seq_chars=[]; quals=[]
            for p in range(start,end):
                bases=pos_bases.get(p,[])
                if len(bases) < min_depth:
                    seq_chars.append("N"); quals.append(0); continue
                if mode=="simple":
                    if use_qual:
                        scores=defaultdict(float)
                        for b,q in bases: scores[b]+= (q if q!=255 else 0)
                        total=sum(scores.values()) or 1
                        best=max(scores, key=lambda b: scores[b]); frac=scores[best]/total
                    else:
                        cnt=Counter(b for b,q in bases); total=sum(cnt.values()); best=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; frac=cnt[best]/total
                    if ambig:
                        # combine bases with at least het_fract of best?
                        cnt=Counter(b for b,q in bases)
                        # bases present at >=? Use het fract: second base at least het_fract *? Simplified IUPAC if top two both >=...
                        sorted_bases=cnt.most_common()
                        if len(sorted_bases)>=2 and sorted_bases[1][1]/total >= 0.25:  # placeholder
                            code=iupac_code([sorted_bases[0][0],sorted_bases[1][0]])
                            seq_chars.append(code); quals.append(int(30)); continue
                    if frac < call_fract:
                        seq_chars.append("N"); quals.append(0)
                    else:
                        seq_chars.append(best); quals.append(int(round(frac*40)) if False else 30)
                    # qual for simple: based on ?
                    # recompute qual as ... keep last appended? We already appended; adjust:
                    # For FASTQ output qualities original simple mode gives ??? We'll set qual based on depth/fract: min(60, int(frac*...))
                    quals[-1]= min(60, int( (sum(q for b,q in bases if b==best)/max(1,sum(1 for b,q in bases if b==best)) ) ) ) if bases else 0
                    if not use_qual:
                        # average qual of agreeing bases capped
                        agreeing=[q for b,q in bases if b==best and q!=255]
                        quals[-1]= int(sum(agreeing)/len(agreeing)) if agreeing else 0
                else:
                    # bayesian weighted
                    scores={}
                    for base in "ACGT":
                        score=0.0
                        for b,q in bases:
                            qq=q if q!=255 else 33  # missing as B? earlier consensus FASTQ used ?? Use 33 for *?
                            # error prob
                            if qq>60: qq=60
                            p_err=10**(-qq/10)
                            if b==base: score+= math.log10(1-p_err) if p_err<1 else -10
                            else: score+= math.log10(p_err/3) if p_err>0 else -10
                        scores[base]=score
                    best=max(scores, key=lambda b: scores[b])
                    # second best diff
                    sorted_scores=sorted(scores.values(), reverse=True)
                    diff=sorted_scores[0]-sorted_scores[1] if len(sorted_scores)>1 else 10
                    # consensus qual phred like diff*10?
                    qual_val=int(min(60, max(0, diff*10)))
                    # If diff small (ambiguous), call N as in toy: threshold?
                    if diff < 0.5:  # tie-ish
                        seq_chars.append("N" if not ambig else iupac_top2(bases))
                        quals.append(0 if not ambig else qual_val)
                    else:
                        seq_chars.append(best); quals.append(qual_val)
            consensus_seq="".join(seq_chars)
        if fmtout=="FASTA":
            out.write(f">{chrom}\n")
            for i in range(0,len(consensus_seq),line_len): out.write(consensus_seq[i:i+line_len]+"\n")
        elif fmtout=="FASTQ":
            out.write(f"@{chrom}\n")
            for i in range(0,len(consensus_seq),line_len): out.write(consensus_seq[i:i+line_len]+"\n")
            out.write("+\n")
            qstr="".join(chr(min(q,93)+33) for q in quals)
            for i in range(0,len(qstr),line_len): out.write(qstr[i:i+line_len]+"\n")
        elif fmtout=="PILEUP":
            # Use mpileup-like but in consensus pileup format: ref pos qual? Original consensus PILEUP lines: ref, pos(0based?), depth, refbase?, qual, bases, quals - from earlier: "ref 7 0 1 N 0 T ~" columns: chr, pos0?, offset?, depth, ... Hard approximate using mpileup generation?
            # Generate via calling mpileup logic simplified: reuse per position bases
            for p in range(start,end):
                bases=pos_bases.get(p,[])
                depth=len(bases)
                if depth < min_depth and not show_all: continue
                cons=consensus_seq[p-start] if consensus_seq else "N"
                qv=quals[p-start] if quals else 0
                basestr="".join(b for b,q in bases) if bases else "*"
                qualstr="".join(chr(min(q,93)+33) for b,q in bases) if bases else "*"
                refb=refseq.get(chrom,"N"* (p+1))[p].upper() if chrom in refseq and p < len(refseq[chrom]) else "N"
                out.write(f"{chrom}\t{p+1}\t0\t{depth}\t{refb}\t{qv}\t{basestr}\t{qualstr}\n")
    if outpath: out.close()
    return 0
def iupac_code(bases):
    s=set(bases)
    table={frozenset("AC"):"M",frozenset("AG"):"R",frozenset("AT"):"W",frozenset("CG"):"S",frozenset("CT"):"Y",frozenset("GT"):"K",frozenset("ACG"):"V",frozenset("ACT"):"H",frozenset("AGT"):"D",frozenset("CGT"):"B",frozenset("ACGT"):"N"}
    return table.get(frozenset(s),"N")
def iupac_top2(bases_list):
    cnt=Counter(b for b,q in bases_list)
    top=[b for b,c in cnt.most_common(2)]
    return iupac_code(top) if len(top)==2 else top[0]

def cmd_reference(argv,args):
    opts,rest=parse_opts(args,"r:eo:q@:e",["region=","output=","threads="],"reference")

    if not rest:
        # stdin?
        header,records,fmt=detect_and_read("-")

        header,records,fmt=detect_and_read(rest[-1])
    outpath=get_opt(d,['-o']); out=open(outpath,'w') if outpath else sys.stdout

    region_arg=get_opt(d,['-r','--region'])
    regimes=[parse_region_str(region_arg)] if region_arg else [(n,0,l) for n,l in refs]

        seq="N"*(e-s)

        # group by RG? Group column: all and sample? Toy group: all and '-' (no sample)
        def compute(recs):
            # flag+seq: crc of (flag masked + seq oriented?) ; +name incremental etc. Use cumulative CRC sums like stats?

                seq=r.seq if r.seq!="*" else ""
                if not has_opt(d,'-c','--no-rev-comp') and (r.flag & 0x10):

                flagmasked=r.flag & mask
                c_flagseq=(c_flagseq + (binascii.crc32(struct.pack("<H",flagmasked)+seq.encode()) & 0xffffffff)) & 0xffffffff
                c_name=(c_name + (binascii.crc32(r.qname.encode()) & 0xffffffff)) & 0xffffffff
                qb=bytes([255]*len(seq)) if r.qual=="*" else bytes([ord(c)-33 for c in r.qual])
